relationships.subject: anti-VEGF therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, nvAMD can be treated with vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) inhibitors, known as anti-VEGF therapy6–8 applied via injections in the vitreous of the eye.

relationships.subject: anti-VEGF therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: All of the interviewees described feeling the sting of the injection, despite the anaesthetic

key_findings: Qualitative interviews of 22 nvAMD patients in Germany found anti-VEGF injections were uncomfortable and anxiety-provoking, with pain and perceived lack of effect driving wishes to discontinue.
Respectful, explanatory communication from medical staff eased anxiety and supports adherence.
